summary: The Tidal Palace is the royal seat of the Plane of Water. Coral halls, waterglass corridors, and cascading chambers form the domain of the Tide Monarch, ruler of the elemental tides.
history: The palace was shaped from living coral during the rise of the first Tide Monarch.
Waterglass corridors were crafted using abyssal pressure and elemental artistry.
Tidal cascades were added to regulate the palace’s shifting structure.
The Tide Monarch’s sanctum became the center of elemental diplomacy and power.
